reason: Original p339 explicitly enumerates six distinct zodiac sign classifications; source reader C bundled six into one clause.

superseded_in_index_but_retained_raw.source_statement: The source's sign classifications are: many children—♋, ♏, ♓; few children—♈, ♉, ♎, ♐, ♑, ♒; diverse shapes or forms—♊, ♋, ♐, ♒; barren—♊, ♌, ♍; direct ascensions—♋, ♌, ♍, ♎, ♏, ♐; oblique ascensions—♑, ♒, ♓, ♈, ♉, ♊.
preconditions: Apply these printed classifications where the surrounding number-of-thieves rules invoke them.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The lists overlap; they have not been reconciled or replaced with modern classifications.
